newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share prices seen moving in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share prices seen moving in narrow range.

text.p: Jakarta share prices are likely to move in a narrow range on Friday, with players likely to continue taking profit in selected blue-chips, brokers said.
"Players are waiting for more information about the government's next deregulation package and how it would impact on their shareholding," one broker said.

The government is likely to postpone the announcement of the planned economic deregulation until the end of July as the ministers involved in the drafting of the package needed more time to discuss the policy, Harian Ekonomi Neraca daily reported.
The package had previously been expected to be announced later this month.
Brokers said players were likely to continue taking profit in selected blue-chips due to a lack of fresh market factors.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed down 2.34 points, or 0.33 percent, at 708.45 points after touching a day low of 706.08 points.
